name: slopnuke
description: Sweep a repo's code comments, markdown, code strings and test names for AI writing slop with SlopSift, and have the agent rewrite each finding until a rescan is clean.

interface.shortDescription: Rewrite AI slop until a rescan is clean.
interface.longDescription: slopnuke runs SlopSift on the code comments, markdown, code strings and test names of a repo, or on edited files, hands the findings to Codex as a rewrite task, and rescans until the files are clean or the findings stop dropping.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $slopnuke:slopnuke to clean AI slop out of the comments and markdown in this repo.
